description: Create self-destructing notes and share them securely with friends.
create_note_description: Create secure, self-destructing notes that disappear after being read or after a set time period.
create_note_details: Your notes are encrypted and can be protected with a password. Add an email to receive notifications when your note is read or destroyed. Perfect for sharing sensitive information securely.

note_ready_description: Share this secure link with the intended recipient. Remember, the note will self-destruct after being read.
link_copied_error: Failed to copy link. Please try again.
note_destroyed_error: Failed to destroy note. Please try again.
